components.html: The personal information collected on this form is for the purpose of assessing eligibility for the BC Children and Youth Disability Benefit. We are collecting your personal information under section 26(c) of the Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act. The Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act protects the personal information from unauthorized use and disclosure. If you have any questions about the collection, use, or disclosure of this information, please contact the Director of Service Transition at the Children and Youth with Support Needs (CYSN) Policy Branch, at MCF.ChildrenYouthSupportNeeds@gov.bc.ca or by mail at PO Box 9719 Stn Prov Govt, Victoria, BC V8W 9S1.
components.label: Content

components.html:
• This form should only be completed by families of children and youth who are currently eligible for Autism Funding in BC, and who have been asked to complete the form by the Ministry of Children and Family Development to assess eligibility for the BC Children and Youth Disability Benefit. It is not a general application form for the BC Children and Youth Disability Benefit.
  • Only information submitted through this form will be considered as part of assessing your child or youth’s eligibility for the BC Children and Youth Disability Benefit.
  • You must complete all the mandatory fields, shown with a red asterisk (*), before you can submit this form.
  • Before you begin to complete the form, please gather all the documentation you wish to submit and then submit the form only once per child.
  • You need to combine all pages of each assessment into 1 file. Please do not upload individual pages of the same assessment in separate files.

components.html:
Attention:
Are you sure you do not wish to submit assessment information? If you do not wish to submit assessment information at this time, the Ministry of Children and Family Development will be unable to assess whether your child is eligible to transition from Autism Funding to the BC Children and Youth Disability Benefit. If you do not wish to participate in this process, you can apply for the BC Children and Youth Disability Benefit after April 1, 2027, noting that if eligible, you may not begin to receive the Disability Benefit until after the conclusion of Autism Funding.
